summary.text: Brandon Cox is a Republican state representative from Berkeley County who has represented South Carolina House District 92 since 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A military veteran and retired president and CEO of Threat Management Group, he faces Democrat Byron Walters in the general election, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Brandon Cox was born in Fayetteville, North Carolina, and his family's roots are in Pamplico, South Carolina, according to Ballotpedia and the House member page.

The House page lists his military service as active and reserve U.S. Air Force duty from 1996 to 2012, along with training at the Naval School Explosive Ordnance Disposal, Army Air Assault School and Navy Dive School.
Cox served on the Goose Creek City Council from 2016 to 2018 and on Berkeley County Council, District 5, from 2019 to 2022, according to the House member page.
His committee assignments are Medical, Military, Public and Municipal Affairs, and Operations and Management, where he is second vice chairman.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Cox listed the key messages of his campaign as safety, budget and quality, and said he was passionate about safety through recruiting first responders and law enforcement.
